# /crav1-explain-this-code

[All skills](../skills.md) · Walkthrough: [Explain this code](../../from-explain-this-code.md) · Playbook: [`SKILL.md`](../../../.cursor/skills/crav1/crav1-explain-this-code/SKILL.md)

## Purpose

Explain one piece of code (a file, a function, a selection, or a PR diff) from reading it.

**[`/crav1-explain-this-code`](crav1-explain-this-code.md)** explains a file, a function, a selection, or a PR diff in the chat. It asks what to explain when nothing is named. It opens with one question: what it does (Recommended), what and why, or teach the language, and skips it when the wording answers. A headless or bot run with no choice word stops and lists the words. It reads only the code and the code it calls and never guesses. What and why takes reasons only from the code, specs, plan decisions, system notes, and commits, and says `no stated reason found` otherwise. Teach the language adds idiom notes, a one-line comparison to a language the user knows, and topics to look up next. Every answer has a small mermaid flowchart built from what was read. At the end it offers Save as .md to the Downloads folder, after showing the full path. It is not [`/crav1-explain-existing-system`](crav1-explain-existing-system.md), which reads `docs/system/`.

## Choice words

Exact words for bots and scripted runs (no `--flags`). A word in the invocation takes that choice without asking. A headless or bot run with no word stops and names the valid words.

| Question | Word | Means |
| --- | --- | --- |
| How deep | `what it does` | what it does |
| How deep | `what and why` | what and why |
| How deep | `teach the language` | teach the language |

## Runs when

You want one piece of code explained. Called by the user.

## Prompts

Prompt budget: 3 (the most prompts in one run, the closing yes included). A prompt may hold several questions. See the asking rule in `crav1.mdc`.

## Reads

In short: The named code, the code it calls, and for why also specs, plans, system notes, and commits.

Reads the named file, function, selection, or PR diff and the workspace code it calls. What and why also reads `docs/specs/`, plan decisions, `docs/system/`, and `git log`/`git blame`.

## Writes

In short: Nothing (an explanation in chat); a .md in Downloads only when the user says yes.

Writes the explanation and a mermaid flowchart in the chat. On Save as .md, after the user confirms the full path, writes `explain-this-code-<target>-<date>.md` to `~/Downloads` (or `%USERPROFILE%\Downloads`) or a path the user names, with a header naming the paths and `<branch>@<short sha>`.

## Does not

Leaves code, specs, `docs/`, and the rest of the kit layout alone. Never writes into the repo by default.

Limits and exceptions: never guesses; says `not read` for code it could not read and `no stated reason found` for a step with no stated reason. The kit never reads or indexes a saved file.

## You run next / Runs by itself

- You run next: Nothing in particular.
- Runs by itself: Calls no skill.
